$Comment: Santa, Christmas's host, standing in the Forgotten Temple while Christmas runs. The role, this
placement and the conversation pressing F opens all ship in this pack. Interact names the
conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Santa.json) rather than a screen, because Santa has
lines to say before any list opens. Author Dialogue or Open, never both.
Season is what makes Santa a guest: the placement stands only while the calendar event Christmas is
switched on and running, so he arrives when it starts and leaves when it ends, is stopped by a
command, or is switched off. The library looks at every placement again at each start and end, so
neither needs a restart. Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded (which is also what lets the end of
Christmas find him and clear the spot), stands him up again if something removes him, and raises his
health past anything that can be dealt.
Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id, which stays the same on every visit while the
world's name does not. This placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character IS the role:
Christmas's quests bind to Christmas_Santa.
Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset. A player arrives facing negative X and walks a
stone path three blocks wide (Z within 1.5 of the spot) into the round hall, past a row of statues
and stone benches three blocks to either side. Fourteen blocks along negative X and eight along
negative Z is the open marble floor on the hall's north side, behind that row, eight blocks further
in than Martha the Cook's spot (X -6), which she keeps while Harvest Feast's last days overlap the
start of Christmas; Yaw 180 faces positive Z, towards the path. Once the feast is over, Elsie the
Weaver stands four blocks to his east (X -10) and Tomas the Miller four to his west (X -18), each
with a stall of their own. To move Santa, edit Anchor.WorldSpawn.Offset and Yaw, keeping a Z offset
between -7 and -10 (nearer than -7 meets the statue row; past -10 is the north wall), then look at
the spot in game. To take him out without editing this file, set enabled (lower case, as that file
spells it) to false for this id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Props are Santa's corner, drawn while he stands, each offset from his spot along the world's own
axes, and Y lifts a block off the floor by half its drawn height, because a block is drawn centred on
the point it is given: a small snowy fir to his east, stacked from the game's fir trunk and three
shrinking blocks of snowy fir leaves (Scale draws a block smaller or larger), the game's snowflake
topper on it, three of the game's Christmas Packets under it, and the game's snowman to his west.
They move with him.
Name: Christmas_Santa_Temple
